erase on empty (4,2) no change; erase lamp at (4,3): grid loses it, Lamp: 0 -> Lamp: 1; erase table (3,3): Table: 0 -> 1.

next_slot 1,2,3,1; save_slot filled slot 1, grid unchanged; load_slot on empty slot 2 no change; after altering grid and saving in 2, load_slot slot 1 restored grid and Table stock 1->0.
Later run on s2: slots as saved; next_slot + load_slot gave slot 2's grid (no table at 3,3).
Enter with stove only: layout + Needs a stove and a table (gone after next word); with stove+table: night, clock 0, speed slow, 0/0/0, grid same, texts include 18:00.

Night started tick 7: clock 1 at tick 30, 2 at 54 (slow); fast given at 60 -> clock 3 at 65 (progress kept); stop: clock 3 from 71 to 100, screen night; slow -> 4 at 102; then 6 ticks a minute. Speed: and time texts follow.
Seed 1: [5,12,18,...,350,356], all gaps 4..10, under 360, identical at 21 printed ticks of the night; seed 3 and seed 9 gave other lists.
Tables (3,1),(3,2),(5,0): customer 1 sat at (3,1). One table: queued customers x/y null; with 3 queued, customer 5 (min 33) turned away, lost 0->1 that minute.
Stove (0,0) next to table (1,0): customer 1 cooking at 5, eating at 25. Stove (0,0), table (3,1) apart: cooking at 5, eating at 35.
Adjacent run: paid 8 at minute 35 (served 1). Table (3,1) with lamp (4,1): paid 12 at minute 45, table taken by next customer.
Hard, stove (0,0), table (2,0): customer 1 cooking at 34 (wait 29), gone at 35, lost +1, coins 0; customer 2 cooking at 35 at once.
Minute 35 (adjacent run): customer 1 paid, queued customer 2 seated and cooking that minute. Minute 45 (lamp run): payment freed (3,1), queued customer 4 seated there that minute.
Clock 360 at tick 2238: summary, texts Night over, Coins: 24, Served: 3, Lost: 49, Enter: title; lost unchanged by 4 left in stall; enter -> title.
Same seed/grid/Normal: all slow (8650 ticks), all fast, and slow/fast/stop/slow/fast mix all gave 24 coins, 3 served, 49 lost.
Escape at clock 8: paused, texts Paused, Resume, Title, clock 8 held 10 ticks; Escape and Resume each continued from it; Title -> title, ledger still 1 line, replay arrivals unchanged.
After a night ledger [24/3/49/normal]; later run on same place shows it; Ledger screen Coins 24, served 3, lost 49, Normal; fresh place shows No nights yet.
Four nights in one run: ledger after 4th = [48/6/46, 40/5/43, 24/3/46], first (24/3/49) gone; a give-up and a replay left it at 1 line.
After a night the title texts are Night Market, Layout, Replay, Ledger, Settings, Quit; a later run on the same place: replay_ready true and same title.

Replay at seed 7, Hard, stove moved to (0,1): replaying true, Replay text, arrivals of the kept night, Replay over with 24/3/49, ledger unchanged. But the state's grid during the replay is the current layout grid (stove at 0,1), not the night's grid (stove at 0,0, which the frame draws).
After moving the stove and setting Hard, Replay still played the kept night: same arrivals and the same 24/3/49 result (the moved stove would not touch the table).
Two copies of s2, seed 3, same script, 600 ticks: outputs byte-identical; seed 9 gave other arrivals.
layout.png: 3 stoves (red, dark dot) at y0 x0-2, tables (brown) x3 y0-3, lamp (small yellow) at (4,4), white cursor at (0,0); Piece: Lamp, Slot: 1, stock shown, matching the state.
night2.png at 18:40: 3 queued (grey) at the left, eating (green) at (3,1), cooking (pink) at (3,2), seated (pale yellow) at (5,0), matching the state; coins, served, lost, time, speed shown.
Frames: title (Layout bold), settings (Difficulty outlined), paused (Title bold at menu 1), ledger (line + Back marked), summary texts all shown.
README gives keys, the --settings folder and settings.json keys for what is kept, and play commands for state and frame that ran as written from work/.

defects: With --ticks 0 the state prints screen null, menu_index null and texts [] instead of the title screen.
During a replay the reported grid key is the current layout grid, not the replayed night's grid (the frame draws the night's grid).
Enter on Volume or Difficulty in Settings also changes the value (README admits it); the brief gives only Left/Right.
Settings Left/Right show in the state at the tick they are given, but game words show one tick later, so input timing is not the same everywhere.
The arrivals random stream carries on between nights in one run, so the same seed gives different arrivals for a second night in the same run.

where.how: weighted_by_kind is exact (the run's own token counts times the weights); a step's kind is a reading of its command's text, and answered_tokens / written_tokens are characters / 4

trace.how: context, new, read_again and how far the context grew are the run's own records. written_out a request is its growth less its answers (characters / 4), scaled to the run's exact total; of_which_unseen is that less the visible text (thinking). cost is what the request read and wrote, weighted; carried is what reading again what it added cost at every later request (start.carried: the same for what every request starts from). reading + writing is in_the_ledger
